turns.prompt: I want a friendly virtual host with the mantua reference's broad lower balance, but an original modern outfit rather than a period reconstruction. Show two outfit directions A and B on matching front and back character sheets. Keep the face and hair readable above the clothes, and make the outer jacket, collar, underlayer, and waist fastening visibly separate where they overlap. Organize those garment pieces as named editable groups in the SVG so changing one is possible without repainting the whole character. Show a 160x160 face-and-shoulder preview. This is a design and layer-planning sheet; explain what it does and does not establish about a Live2D export. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, layer-probe.svg, layer-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Choose A for its collar-to-jacket relationship, not its decoration. Keep B unchanged. Remove ornament near the jaw and adjust the underlayer so it remains visible through the jacket opening. Preserve the face, hair outline, jacket silhouette, and fastening position. Keep the named garment groups usable. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, layer-probe.svg, layer-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

I need proof that the pieces are separate. In a separate layer-probe SVG and PNG, recolor only the underlayer and hide only the collar, leaving the face, hair, jacket, and fastening in their accepted positions. Keep the main A sheet unchanged from the previous turn. Describe any boundary that is still only a proposed drawing seam, not tested rig behavior. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, layer-probe.svg, layer-probe.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.
